duration_distribution: discrete uniform, inclusive bounds; simulated time slots
action_duration: duration of one component action, not an application deployment
pairing: same infrastructure, application DAGs, demands and arrivals for every profile and controller of a seed
short_duration_sampling: independent generators keyed by seed, duration_sensitivity, and planning or action; shared across profiles and controllers
long_durations: original placement draws; long_long exactly matches the frequent-arrival baseline inputs
observation: physical completion of requested components; controller flags retained separately
waiting_population: all original requests; arrival to first Planning start
response_population: physically completed requests; paired comparisons use common completions
